title: A Ember for the Thorn
author: Edmund Amberdale
blurb: Emrys Iversen, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
